noodle_queen.judgment: TASTE + FUNCTION + CONTEMPT PASS: the high frozen B against the low traveling A is a memorable contradiction; the deep coil materially earns the snap; the B phase-debt whip and body catch give the clock rule physical consequence; silhouettes and rhythm are specific rather than metronomic; motion is sparse by decision rather than cheapness; causality remains coherent and support truth is never sacrificed for spectacle.

tango.inspection: Actual compiled render inspected across every frame of one complete 45-frame semantic loop from the generated MP4; no source art involved.

iterations.judgment: Visible performance reads as centered async readiness -> rightward/drop anticipation -> deeper compressed coil -> one-tick A snap -> B apex read -> one-tick scoped freeze latch -> B held high while A/COM counter-sweep left -> A near-ground overshoot/deceleration -> one-tick B release -> one-tick B phase-debt whip -> rightward body catch -> B rebound with A lag -> offset restack. Support contacts stay fixed, COM preparation/counterweight/catch remain inside the planted base, bridge spacing accelerates/decelerates instead of equalizing, and the loop pays recovery debt rather than reverse-interpolating or resetting to idle.

keys.causal_role: establish support and asynchronous local clocks

keys.name: READY_ASYNC

keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM shifts right and drops while A folds across torso; feet remain fixed, beginning asymmetric anticipation.

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Lowest/rightmost COM load; A compresses across centerline and knees carry visible preparation before release.
keys.name: DEEP_COIL

keys.motion_arc_root_note: A snaps to high-left extreme while COM springs toward center; B has not yet reached latch phase.
keys.name: A_RELEASE_SNAP

keys.motion_arc_root_note: B reaches high-right apex while A decelerates down; COM counter-shifts left so the future freeze silhouette is already readable.
keys.name: B_APEX_READ

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Scoped event freezes B at already-established apex; no BASE reset and no new B geometry.
keys.name: FREEZE_B_LATCH

keys.causal_role: prove nonparticipant continuation during B freeze
keys.motion_arc_root_note: B stays pinned high while A sweeps low-left and COM deepens left counterweight; knees absorb the continuing motion.
keys.name: A_COUNTERSWEEP_B_HELD

keys.motion_arc_root_note: A passes its low target into a near-ground overshoot, then begins to lose speed; B remains high and frozen.
keys.name: A_OVERSHOOT_DECEL

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Release changes only B authority; A and COM are already recovering, so no idle reset or global phase restart occurs.
keys.name: RELEASE_B

keys.motion_arc_root_note: B whips from frozen high to low-right extreme in one authored spike, visibly spending accumulated phase debt.
keys.name: B_PHASE_DEBT_WHIP

keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM follows the B whip into a rightward catch and knee compression; force consequence outlasts the one-tick phase spike.
keys.name: BODY_CATCH_RIGHT

keys.causal_role: secondary lag and readable consequence hold
keys.motion_arc_root_note: B rebounds upward while A trails low; COM returns toward center but remains right-biased, preserving secondary lag.
keys.name: B_REBOUND_A_LAG

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Body restacks one cell left of READY with B still slightly high; recovery is paid before the next loop rather than teleporting to idle.
keys.name: RESTACK_OFFSET
